title: M2 detection input accepted by M3 adapter v1
description: M2 m2.roi.v1 canonical PNG fields take priority; legacy source_roi_base64/mask_base64 aliases remain supported. image_base64 is the unchanged encoder crop. Original RGB bbox fallback requires the same geometry. A null canonical mask overrides a legacy mask alias.

source_crop_png_base64.description: Canonical raw base64 PNG source ROI, RGB; preferred over original image and aliases.

mask_png_base64.description: Canonical binary grayscale PNG in source ROI coordinates, foreground=255; null means unmasked/fallback.

roi_metadata.description: M2 geometry/config/status/fallback retained under m2_roi_metadata in the color descriptor.

mask_base64.description: Plain base64 PNG, single-channel, binary 0/1/255, same H/W and origin as the selected source ROI. Not a full-image mask.

bbox.description: [x1,y1,x2,y2] original-image coordinates, x2/y2 exclusive; required at runtime if original_rgb is provided and source_roi_base64 is absent.
